beats.care: Inter student? Pay through your college between Oct 26 and Nov 9.
beats.what: Telangana's Inter board set the exam fee schedule for March 2027 exams.
beats.why: Paying on time keeps you off the late-fee slabs, which climb to ₹2,000.

cards.body: First-year general students pay ₹540; vocational ₹890. Second-year arts pays ₹540; science and vocational pay ₹890. Miss Nov 9 and late fees kick in: ₹100, then ₹500, ₹1,000 and ₹2,000 till Dec 14.

cards.q: When do you usually pay exam fees?
What's the highest late fee for Inter exam fees?
cards.why: The last window, Dec 9–14, carries a ₹2,000 late fee.

hook: Inter exam fee window opens *Monday*: pay by Nov 9

learn.t: TGBIE is the Telangana Board of Intermediate Education, which runs Class 11–12 exams.
